text:
Hello,

I still haven’t received the VAT invoice for my Contoso Vela Mini, and this delay is unacceptable. Please send the invoice immediately or tell me exactly what is holding it up.

Regards,
Alex
我的 Contoso AuraBook 14 合盖时被重物压了一下，现在屏幕已经裂了。麻烦告诉我该怎么处理。
您好，我的 Contoso AuraBook Pro 16 从睡眠唤醒后经常闪屏或黑屏一秒，今天还要用它参加线上答辩，请尽快帮我解决，谢谢。
你好，我的 Contoso AuraBook Pro 16 现在掉电比刚开始用时快得多，想问下怎么排查。
Please delete my account and all data collected from my Contoso Titan G7, and confirm completion within the GDPR one-month deadline because I’m worried about this dragging on.
你好，我的 Contoso Titan G7 上 Contoso Vantage 一打开就闪退，重启后还是一样。现在完全用不了，我有点着急，能帮我看看怎么恢复吗？
I dropped my Contoso Titan G7, and now one corner is badly dented and there’s a crack running through the case. I’m worried it may not be safe to keep using—what should I do?

Hi, my Contoso Nimbus 2-in-1 completed a BIOS update, but afterward it stopped starting altogether. Pressing the power button does not bring up the logo or the operating system, so I’d appreciate guidance on how to recover it.

您好！

AuraBook Pro 16提示硬盘可能很快损坏，文件打开特别慢，我已备份好文件，但今天还要用它提交毕业论文，麻烦尽快帮我解决。

谢谢
陈晨

Hello,

I’m worried because my Vela Mini shows a firmware error screen every time I turn it on, although it continues booting and works normally afterward. Could you please tell me what I should do?

Thanks,
Megan
Um, when I start my AuraBook 14, a firmware error screen comes up first. It then carries on and starts normally, so I’d like to know how to stop that screen from appearing.

Hi, my Vela Mini gets very hot and shuts itself off whenever I run demanding software. I need it working today because I’m giving an online training session this afternoon, so, uh, I’d appreciate help getting it stable before then.
你好，我想获取你们持有的关于我的全部个人数据，以及Vela Mini上传的所有设备遥测数据的副本。请按GDPR规定在收到请求后一个月内提供，我担心会错过这个法定期限，麻烦尽快确认。
My Titan G7 becomes extremely hot when I put it under load, such as during gaming or video rendering. After a while, it switches itself off without warning.
你好，呃，我这台AuraBook Pro 16的实时字幕已经完全不能用了，背景虚化和Contoso AI Assistant也一直转圈超时，真的很耽误事。我今天下午要用它做一场有听障同事参加的客户演示，必须用到字幕和虚化，麻烦赶紧帮我恢复。

Hi, I’m calling because my AuraBook Pro 16 started giving off a burning smell while it was charging, and I saw a small amount of smoke near the charging port. I’ve unplugged it, but honestly, this is really concerning and I need to know what to do next.
